description: Add notes to a region of a score, up to 2,000 a call. Each note: pitch (a MIDI number 0–127, decimals allowed: 60.5 is a quarter-tone above middle C; or a name such as C3 or F#4; C4 is 60, middle C), at_beats (from the region’s start), length_beats and velocity (1–127, how hard it is struck). On a drum kit or a sliced sampler a pitch selects a sound, not a height (score.get lists which pitch plays what). at_seconds and length_seconds may be given in place of the beats, which puts a note on an exact moment, on the grid or off it. Exactly what is passed is stored: nothing is moved to a grid or a scale. Returns the new score_id (edit that one next) and note_ids in the order given.

notes.description: [{pitch, at_beats, length_beats, velocity}], or at_seconds and length_seconds for the two positions

velocity.description: 1 to 127: how hard it is struck
